measurement: Files declared by payload-manifest.json; payload-manifest.json itself is excluded.
rationale: The accepted 2026-11-04 conventional self-contained win-x64 payload keeps required runtime, WebView2, extension, profile, broker, installer, update code, lifecycle cleanup, and empty-statement screenshot support while removing unreachable embedded diagnostics and unsupported satellite resources. Empty-statement screenshot support increased UsbWebLauncher.App.dll by 10,240 bytes without changing the payload file set. Production two-row header detection and maximized empty-statement capture added 470 bytes to the measured two-digit release payload. The committed Windows CRLF checkout contract adds 1,066 bytes compared with the mixed-line-ending development tree and makes byte-for-byte payload measurements stable across clean local and GitHub Actions checkouts. A two-digit release sequence adds 1,021 bytes of measured assembly version metadata above the base-version payload. Any further growth requires an explicit reviewed update.

singleFileEvaluation.reason: The candidate passed the non-hardware .NET suite, JavaScript suite, packaging scripts, signing-target presence check, update-handoff coverage, footprint bounds, and startup smoke test. Payload compatibility failed because single-file publishing bundled the required zh-Hans satellite resources and removed the external UsbWebLauncher.App.dll, UsbWebLauncher.Core.dll, and UsbWebLauncher.Windows.dll files required by the broker trusted-client hash policy. The installer gate therefore stopped at payload validation without weakening the contract.
